source: Papkou et al. (2023), Science 382:eadh3860; Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.8228920 (in_data/fitness_data_wt.rds), CC BY 4.0
analysis_unit: 9-nucleotide sequence of E. coli folA codons 26-28 (4^9 = 262,144; 261,333 measured)
objective: maximize fitness (log growth under trimethoprim relative to the wild type GCCGATCTC)
budget: 1,000 distinct sequences measured per run (0.38% of the space)
ground_truth: codons {1,2,3}, {4,5,6}, {7,8,9} and pair epistasis from the full table, used only to score DAMICORE's groups
metrics: share of runs reaching the top 70 measured sequences, and the global optimum
best fitness found per run and evaluations until the top 70
share of DAMICORE groupings in which each pair of positions shares a group
codon test: rank and exact p-value of the codon split among all 280 splits into three triples
Spearman correlation between pair co-grouping and pair epistasis
damicore_roles: position groups over the promising sequences of each generation
